description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {R}
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Carnival of Souls triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
